name: anamorphic-flare
title: Anamorphic Flare
description: A point of light stretches into a cinematic horizontal streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo behind it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .af-logo element.
useWhen: A film, studio, automotive or premium product needs a cinematic opener with a lens-flare look.
You want a fast left-to-right sweep that has a centered logo fully revealed by about 0.7 s.
avoidWhen: The light should search and land on the logo like a stage light: use spotlight.
You want warm light flooding a cut between two scenes, not a logo reveal: use light-leak.
author: Remocn
